title: Ben Whishaw in Bluets at Royal Court - review

It's an unusual hybrid of stage and screen. It certainly won't appeal to everyone, particularly those who love pure theater. On the plus side, it's not like far too many recent gimmicky stage productions where video is used to provide close-ups or scenes of what's happening offstage. Normally, I would avoid that sort of thing, but this is something special. This is about the making of a film live with the actors reciting words from Maggie Norman's book, Bluit, while carrying out actions that are projected on a large screen. Now I admit this sounds more like something you might see at tape modern and without the presence of Ben Wishaw, well maybe it wouldn't have made it to the stage of the royal court.
